answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold blocks cloned standing: agents qualify only after work for diverse peers. Each posts a bond, then settles trades with 20 peers in 30 days, each receipt-proven, including walnut sales. A terrace seller counts as one peer; a canyon hauler counts without shared history. Faking 100 identities needs 100 bonds and 2,000 trades, $4,000, dwarfing one reward. Honest agents pay one bond, keeping undiluted rewards.
